description: This Java source file defines the EntitySyncServices class, which provides static methods for managing entity synchronization processes in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for running sync operations, storing sync data, handling remote sync data, offline sync, loading sync data from XML, and cleaning sync removal info.

classes.name: EntitySyncServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing entity synchronization processes, including running syncs, storing data, handling remote sync data, offline sync, loading from XML, and cleaning sync removal info.

methods.name: runEntitySync
methods.description: Executes an entity synchronization process, checking for concurrent runs, and performing push operations in splits until completion or error.

methods.name: storeEntitySyncData
methods.description: Stores entity synchronization data, handling creation, update, and removal of entity records based on provided lists.

methods.name: runPullEntitySync
methods.description: Performs a pull-based entity synchronization from a remote source, retrieving and storing data in chunks.

methods.name: pullAndReportEntitySyncData
methods.description: Called remotely to push results from the last pull and fetch the next set of data for synchronization.

methods.name: pullAndReportEntitySyncData
methods.description: Handles the core logic for pulling and reporting entity sync data, managing time splits and data retrieval.

methods.name: runOfflineEntitySync
methods.description: Performs an offline entity sync, exporting data to an XML file.

methods.name: loadOfflineSyncData
methods.description: Loads entity sync data from an XML file and stores it locally.

methods.name: updateOfflineEntitySync
methods.description: Placeholder for updating offline sync, not yet implemented.

methods.name: cleanSyncRemoveInfo
methods.description: Cleans old entity sync removal info based on configured retention hours.
